# Code editor browser assets

Pinned local assets; loaded only when the Custom source editor opens. No CDN is contacted at runtime.

- CodeMirror 5.65.21 (MIT): https://github.com/codemirror/codemirror5/tree/5.65.21
  Core, JavaScript mode, matchbrackets, foldcode, foldgutter, brace-fold, comment-fold.
- js-beautify 1.15.4 (MIT): https://github.com/beautifier/js-beautify/tree/v1.15.4
  JavaScript formatter only, loaded on first format. Formatting does not validate syntax.

Distribution files are from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/codemirror/5.65.21/ and https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/js-beautify/1.15.4/beautify.min.js . Licenses are included alongside the files.
